key_idea: When you fold a net, two faces with one face between them in a straight line end up opposite.
steps: In the column, 5 and 4 have the 7 between them, so 5 and 4 end up opposite.
Check: 2 and 7 are opposite (2 + 7 = 9), and 1 and 8 are opposite (1 + 8 = 9). Every pair makes 9.

choice_feedback.D: 7 touches 5 in the net, so it is next to 5, not opposite.
